page: Microsoft Azure DC32ds_v3 is a memory-optimized server instance from the DDCSv3 family, powered by an Intel Xeon 8370C processor running at 2.8 GHz. Built on the x86_64 architecture, this instance features 32 dedicated physical cores with a 1:1 thread-to-core ratio, eliminating hyperthreading. It is equipped with 256.0 GB of RAM, providing 8.0 GB of memory per core. The processor includes 48 MB of L3 cache, 1 MB of L2 cache, and 48 KB of L1d cache. Storage is bundled with 2458 GB of local disk capacity, and the instance is Premium Storage capable.

In benchmark evaluations, the DC32ds_v3 demonstrates strong multi-core performance, highlighted by a stress-ng multi-core score of 60370.55 and a Geekbench multi-core score of 17264.0. Its cryptographic capabilities are notable, with a Passmark CPU encryption test score of 36927.97. Database operations are highly efficient, scoring 25047.25 in Passmark database benchmarks, while static web serving throughput reaches 48.38 GB/sec. However, single-core performance is average, with a Geekbench single-core score of 1682.0, and large-model LLM text generation is weak, yielding 2.64 tokens/sec for a 70B model.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the DC32ds_v3 offers a balanced resource profile for memory-intensive and storage-heavy workloads without the overhead of GPU hardware. The combination of dedicated physical cores, high memory density, and substantial local storage makes it highly suitable for database hosting, memory-intensive data processing, static web serving, and cryptographic workloads.
